name: Test Temporary Directory Inheritance
description: Test that subagents inherit working directory from lifecycle hooks

tasks.description: Write a test file in the temporary directory

prompt.template: Create a file named 'test-inheritance.txt' with the content 'hello from task 1'. Use the Write tool to create this file in the current working directory.

tasks.description: Verify the file exists and can be read

prompt.template: List all .txt files in the current working directory and read the contents of 'test-inheritance.txt'. Confirm the file exists and contains 'hello from task 1'.

tasks.description: Write a second file to confirm persistence

prompt.template: Create a file named 'test-inheritance-2.txt' with content 'hello from task 3'. Then list all .txt files to confirm both files exist.
